misconceptions.description: Treating an optimizer's engagement metric (time on page, clicks, completion) as a measure of learning
misconceptions.trigger: learner accepts an optimizer suggestion because it raises time-on-page or completion without asking whether learning improved
misconceptions.feedback: An optimizer reports proxies, not learning. Before accepting a suggestion, ask what learning outcome the metric stands in for and whether the change actually serves it.

misconceptions.description: Accepting every optimizer recommendation as a batch instead of judging each against the learning goal
misconceptions.trigger: learner applies all suggested edits at once without separating the ones that serve learning from the ones that only serve the metric
misconceptions.feedback: Triage the optimizer's list. Accept the suggestions that serve the learning goal, reject the ones that only move a proxy, and record why for each.

misconceptions.description: Assuming the optimizer understands the learners, equity needs, and constraints that only the designer can see
misconceptions.trigger: learner removes a slow but accessible feature because the optimizer flagged it as low-efficiency
misconceptions.feedback: The optimizer does not see your learners or accessibility needs. Weigh its efficiency flags against learner variability the tool cannot measure.
